basic_details.job_title: AAU Recruitment 2026 Notification Out – Apply Online for 310 ATM, BTM, Computer Programmer and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Deputy Project Director, Accountant cum Clerk, Computer Programmer and 2 more
basic_details.short_information: Assam Agricultural University (AAU), Jorhat, has invited applications for 310 posts in 5 roles under Advt No. 5/2026. The posts include Deputy Project Director, Accountant cum Clerk, Computer Programmer, Block Technology Manager and 1 more. The online application is open from 12 November 2026 to 11 December 2026.

age_limit.age_details: Varies by post - see the table below

qualification.education_qualification: Deputy Project Director: Post Graduate in Agriculture & Allied sector; Accountant cum Clerk: B.Com; Computer Programmer: B.Tech or MCA; Block Technology Manager: Post Graduate in Agriculture & Allied sector with Computer skills or Agri Graduate with 5 years as ATM; Assistant Technology Manager: Graduate/Post Graduate (Agri/Allied Sector); plus post-wise experience

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Post Graduate in Agriculture & Allied sector; Minimum 5 years' experience in managerial or supervisory capacity in Agriculture or Allied sector/BTM having 5 years working experience is also eligible. Experience required: Minimum 5 years' experience in managerial or supervisory capacity in Agriculture or Allied sector/BTM having 5 years working experience is also eligible. Age limit: 21 to 40 years. Pay: 52000 per month. Qualification required: B.Com; Minimum 3 years of experience of Accountancy in a reputed organization to the satisfaction of State Government. Experience required: Minimum 3 years of experience of Accountancy in a reputed organization to the satisfaction of State Government. Age limit: 21 to 40 years. Pay: 30000 per month. Qualification required: B.T

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 25,000 to Rs. 52,000 per month, depending on the post

exam_pattern.details: Each question carries 1 mark No negative marks OMR answer sheet; only black/blue ball pen Calculator and mobile phones prohibited; eraser or correction fluid on OMR sheet makes it invalid Exam held zone wise in Guwahati, Tezpur, Jorhat, Silchar, Bongaigaon; centre may vary

how_to_apply: Visit https://online.aau.ac.in/atma-2026 and submit the prescribed online form.
Upload self-attested experience certificate, NOC, qualification certificate, caste certificate etc.
Upload one recent passport size photograph and signature as per prescribed format and size.
Pay the application fee through online mode only.
Submit from 4.00 PM of 12.11.2026 till 4.00 PM of 11.12.2026.
important_instructions: Vacancies may be varied (increase or decrease) in future Exam date, time and venue will be notified through newspapers and www.aau.ac.in Admit card to be downloaded from https://online.aau.ac.in/atma-2026; no separate call letter List of valid/rejected applications will be on www.aau.ac.in No TA/DA for attending the written examination AAU will not issue appointment orders; posts are under the Department of Agriculture, Govt. of Assam

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely contractual; initial engagement of 11 months May be extended for another 11 months at a time based on satisfactory performance and continuation of the project Posts are purely temporary and co-terminus with the project No claim for regular appointment/absorption in Govt. service Service may be discontinued at any time if performance is unsatisfactory Contract Agreement to be signed on a Non-Judicial Stamp Paper of Rs. 20

content_sections.heading: How Will AAU Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: OMR based written test Verification of original documents by the verification committee Selection solely on the basis of merit and marks obtained in the written test Tie: higher marks in requisite qualification examination ranked higher; then senior in age Candidates selected in the written test appear before verification committee for original documents

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 11 December 2026. Applications opened on 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 310 vacancies: 7 Deputy Project Director, 4 Accountant cum Clerk, 9 Computer Programmer, 33 Block Technology Manager, 257 Assistant Technology Manager.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for AAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 11 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General: Rs. 250. Reserved category: Rs. 125. BPL and PWD: No application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Deputy Project Director: 21 to 40 years; Accountant cum Clerk: 21 to 40 years; Computer Programmer: 21 to 40 years; Block Technology Manager: maximum 45 years; Assistant Technology Manager: maximum 45 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 52000 per month for Deputy Project Director, 30000 per month for Accountant cum Clerk, 25000 per month for Computer Programmer, 30,000 per month for Block Technology Manager, 25000 per month for Assistant Technology Manager.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputy Project Director: Post Graduate in Agriculture & Allied sector; Accountant cum Clerk: B.Com; Computer Programmer: B.Tech or MCA; Block Technology Manager: Post Graduate in Agriculture & Allied sector with Computer skills or Agri Graduate with 5 years as ATM; Assistant Technology Manager: Graduate/Post Graduate (Agri/Allied Sector); plus post-wise experience. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be an Indian Citizen as defined in Article 5 to 8 of the Constitution of India. Age calculated only on the basis of the matriculation/HSLC admit card/certificate. Qualification must be held on the date of submission of application. Prescribed experience is needed to qualify for the written test.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for more than one post will have their candidature rejected. Incomplete application forms will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: OMR based written test. Verification of original documents by the verification committee. Selection solely on the basis of merit and marks obtained in the written test. Tie: higher marks in requisite qualification examination ranked higher; then senior in age.
